findings: PY_START and PY_RESUME are local events; PY_THROW is an other/global event.
Local events add to global events rather than masking them.
free_tool_id does not disable local/global events or unregister callbacks; cleanup must explicitly do those first.
DISABLE would suppress future occurrences and must never be returned by counting callbacks.
reference_boundary: Official documentation read; this note pins the reviewer interpretation, not a downloaded whole webpage or an actual interpreter experiment.
